concept_subject: An expandable natural bamboo kitchen drawer organizer (concept design, improved version). A rectangular center tray with 5 long parallel slots sized for full-length dinner knives, plus one sliding side tray on the left and one on the right that pull outward to widen it. Deep compartments with tall walls. Visibly solid, tightly fitted corner joints. Light natural bamboo color with visible vertical bamboo grain, smooth matte finish. Empty, no utensils inside.

locks.geometry: Rectangular tray: 5 long parallel slots in the center section plus 2 sliding side trays (left and right); 7 compartments in total; slots run front to back along the full length.
locks.material: Natural light bamboo with visible vertical grain, smooth matte finish; no paint, no metal parts, no plastic.
locks.scene_scale: Sized for a standard kitchen drawer: about as long as a dinner knife plus a little margin; sits flat on the drawer bottom.
critical_details: P0: 5 long center slots, each long enough for a full dinner knife
P0: 2 side trays that slide outward to widen the organizer
P1: tight, solid corner joints with no gaps
